sentences.text:
This is the fifth bail application under Section 483 of BNSS filed by the applicant for grant of bail after dismissal of earlier one as withdrawn vide order dated 07.08.2025 passed in M.Cr.C. No.
20314 of 2025.

The applicant has been arrested on 19.12.2023 by Police Station- Thatipur, District Gwalior in connection with Crime No.787/2023 registered in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 420, 34 further added 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

The allegation against applicant Jitendra Kumar Shrivastava alias Jeetu is that he had posed himself to be Bhanu Pratap Vaishya and, in collusion with co-accused Chanda alias Chandralekha Jain and Vikram Rana, fraudulently obtained money from the complainant and others on the false pretext of securing government jobs.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:24846 2 MCRC-45088-2025 and has been falsely implicated.
It is contended that the investigation is complete and charge-sheet has been filed.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents, is in custody since 19.12.2023 and no further custodial interrogation is required.

sentences.text: Learned Public Prosecutor for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the case of the present applicant stands on a different footing from that of co-accused Chandralekha Jain, as the applicant is the main accused who had played a key role in the commission of the alleged offence by posing himself to be Bhanu Pratap Vaishya directly inducing the complainant and others to part with a large amount of money.
Heard counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, the period of custody of the applicant and the principle of parity coupled with the fact that the trial is not likely to conclude in near future and prolonged pre- trial detention being an anathema to the concept of liberty, this Court is inclined to extend the benefit of bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:24846 3 MCRC-45088-2025 the concerned Court.

This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant:-
